games.title: Recycling Day
games.hook: Build a small network from pieces and train it to sort cans from bottles. How few pieces will do?
games.alt: Cans and bottles of different sizes, sorted into two bins by a V-shaped divider.

games.title: Rover Route
games.hook: Plan a delivery rover's route from nine measurements taken in mist. You get four bends. Where does the hidden trail really turn?
games.alt: A forest map where the mist has lifted to reveal a winding trail, with a blue route bending twice between the depot and the delivery hut, a shaded strip where the route strays furthest, and a small yellow rover at the hut.

games.title: Downhill Racer
games.hook: Set the robot's move strength and carry-over so it reaches its charger within par, without getting stuck or bouncing past.
games.alt: A small robot on a three-dimensional valley, above the charger at the valley floor.

games.title: Photo Finish
games.hook: Save six rare concert moments. Can 97.5% AI accuracy still leave your album incomplete?
games.alt: A contact sheet of concert photos ranked by score, with two gates, and an album below with five of six moments filled.

games.title: Echo Dancer
games.hook: A dancer performs in one city while an echo dances the routine in another. The link carries two numbers a frame. Which two tracks keep the dance?
games.alt: Two dancers side by side, the original on the left and its echo on the right.

games.title: Next Note
games.hook: Three songbirds write tunes one note at a time. Set the randomness and how many likely notes to keep, so each tune escapes its riff without odd leaps.
games.alt: A piano roll of a tune rising and falling across an octave, above a line divided into the chances of each next note, with a marker showing where this note's luck fell.

games.title: The Wonder Fold
games.hook: A friend says a new paper-plane fold flies 1.5 m farther. Plan the quickest test that backs a real gain at least 80% of the time.
games.alt: Paper-plane landings in two indoor lanes, with each lane's average marked.

games.title: Robot Theatre
games.hook: Write the play's twist, then watch the director stage Act 1 all over again. It counts words and ignores their order.
games.alt: A sad cat hugging a happy ghost on a small stage, a rain cloud above the cat, sparkles above the ghost and a heart between them.
